title: SkillPin
description: Immutable skill pin for a run/thread. Index description stays in context; Skill Resolver Service loads the package from locator.backend (lfs | blob). Client-supplied pins are authz-gated by status + org_allowlist.

skill_id.description: Skill id / folder name (matches skill.yaml name)

description.description: Index card text used in context (from Skill Index); not the full SKILL.md

locator.description: Where Resolver reads the full package (lfs or blob)

status.description: Status at pin time; gateway rejects draft/staging/archived unless caller has pin override role
